2115925329600827500.en_summary: $AMZN CEO Andy Jassy argues that the scale and pace of the AI opportunity justify aggressive upfront CapEx, despite the pressure on near-term FCF. “This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity....Would it be more convenient if this type of acceleration and opportunity happened over 25 years? ... But that's not the world that we live in.” He states they can fund this plan and it will forever change the size of Amazon, its revenue, and free cash flow.
2115925329600827500.zh_summary: $AMZN CEO Andy Jassy 認為 AI 機會的規模與速度足以證明積極的前期資本支出是合理的，儘管對近期自由現金流造成壓力。「這是千載難逢的機會……如果這種加速與機會發生在 25 年內會更方便嗎？……但那不是我們所處的世界。」他表示他們可以資助此計劃，這將永遠改變亞馬遜的規模、收入與自由現金流。

ticker_notes.AMZN: AI 機會為千載難逢，積極 CapEx 將永遠改變公司規模、收入與自由現金流

2115924406094700702.en_summary: $INTC CEO sees server CPU market growing 5x to over $200B in five years as AI agents take off, saying “the ratio of CPU to GPUs used to be 1-to-8 and now it is 1-to-4.” That's effectively twice as many CPUs per GPU as AI agents run more code and tools, which could create another massive growth opportunity for $AMD, $ARM and $NVDA beyond GPUs alone.
2115924406094700702.zh_summary: $INTC CEO 認為隨著 AI 代理起飛，伺服器 CPU 市場將在五年內增長 5 倍至超過 2000 億美元，表示「CPU 與 GPU 的比例過去是 1 對 8，現在是 1 對 4」。這實質上是每個 GPU 對應兩倍的 CPU，因為 AI 代理運行更多代碼與工具，這可能為 $AMD、$ARM 和 $NVDA 在 GPU 之外創造另一個巨大增長機會。

ticker_notes.INTC: 伺服器 CPU 市場五年內增長5倍至超過2000億美元
ticker_notes.NVDA: CPU 與 GPU 比例變化可能帶來 GPU 以外增長機會
